Bangladesh daily electricity demand: from raw data to a model

One page, no server. Data and the trained model are inside this file.

Read before using the numbers.
  • This is a working result, not a final or perfect model.
  • This page uses the F3 recipe, rebuilt from re-downloaded public data. It takes the same-day wind and cloud as they happened (NASA POWER, four zones: Dhaka, Chattogram, Rajshahi, Sylhet). That weather is not known the day before, so this is not a true day-ahead forecast. The earlier F1 model used weather forecasts that could not be collected again.
  • The rebuild scores 4.80% on the frozen test; the original run reported 4.77%. The small gap is most likely a different NASA download (zone coordinates were not recorded).
  • 2025 to 2026 was used earlier for load-shedding work and five demand days were printed, so it is no longer a clean holdout.
  • Gain over "tomorrow = today" for the built-in data (95% block bootstrap): overall +60 MW (-2 to +128, so it does not clearly exclude zero), 2025 +108 MW (+35 to +173), 2026 -21 MW (-142 to +95).

Use a different CSV

Pick a CSV with the same columns as the built-in one. Everything on all tabs is recomputed in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
